title: 第十三章 姜辰太热情了第十四章 章安仁
content_zh:
“那就麻烦陈小姐了，我就买几件衣服。”姜辰心中一喜。
虽然签到系统说，在女主面前签到的时候每个女主只能一次，不过他对签到系统也不了解，更不知道这签到系统会不会还有其他的功能。
所以，在姜辰看来，和那些影视剧中的女主多多接触说不定可以触发系统的其他功能。
“那不知道姜先生是想要买什么牌子的衣服？”陈茜茜问道。
“我觉得买衣服看的不是牌子，而应该看穿的是否舒服。陈小姐，你觉得呢？”姜辰前世的时候，曾经一度喜欢那些名牌。甚至在赚钱之前，买了不少中档品牌的衣服。
但现在他想明白了。
这种行为是暴发户的行为。
所以，现在他虽然算得上是亿万富翁，但也不怎么买高端品牌的原因。
“姜先生说的是。”
陈茜茜能够说什么？
她怀疑姜辰在装十三，可惜没证据。
“走，我们进去看看吧。”
姜辰和陈茜茜进了一家大牌服饰的专卖店。
因为是姜辰买衣服，所以，进入专卖店后，看的都是男装。
专卖店还是很大的，里面人来人往的，证明了这里的人气和品质。
“先生，请问有什么可以帮您的。”销售小姐姐一看到姜辰和陈茜茜这一队俊男靓女就知道来了大客户了，当下就笑容热情且灿烂的说道。
“这几套我看着不错，取下来让我试试，”姜辰完全没有听销售介绍的意思。
姜辰也不看这衣服是不是好看，只要合身，他就买下。
“这件合适。”
“这件也不错。”

“嗯，这件我要了。”
连着试了几件衣服，只要姜辰看着觉得顺眼的，他就点头让销售小姐姐包了起来。
没过多久，两人出来了。和进去之前不同的是，姜辰和陈茜茜手中多了几套衣服。嗯，其实也没有多多少，姜辰除了自己买了几件之外，也就是去女装店给陈茜茜买了一套衣服而已，价格也很便宜，不过几千块而已，算是给陈茜茜的礼物。
陈茜茜是十分的推脱的。
如果不是因为姜辰的坚持，恐怕说什么也不会要。
“一件衣服而已，你又何必在意呢？如果不是你陪我逛街，我说不定无聊死。”姜辰和陈茜茜并排走在一起笑着道。
陈茜茜是觉得和姜辰才第二次见面就收了他一件衣服感觉不好意思。
两个小时后，姜辰和陈茜茜都有些累了。
“陈小姐，今天谢谢你了，要不我请你吃饭？”姜辰对陈茜茜说道。
“不了，我还有事。”陈茜茜摇摇头。
姜辰太热情了。
她觉得姜辰可能对她有意思，这让她不知所措，甚至后悔之前叫住姜辰了，所以此时她也不想和姜辰多呆。
“那以后有时间我再请你吧。”姜辰没有勉强。
虽然和陈茜茜在一起的感觉不错，甚至他也有发展下去的打算，但毕竟两人这才是第二次见面，如果继续纠缠下去，只会弄巧成拙。
和陈茜茜告别后，姜辰就回到了自己的住处。
这次他就花了十几万，衣服前后加起来就买了十来套，鞋子也买了一些。
content_en:
"Then please excuse me, Miss Chen. I'll buy some clothes." Jiang Chen felt happy.
Although the sign-in system said that each heroine could only sign in once in front of the heroine, he didn't know much about the sign-in system, let alone whether the sign-in system would have other functions.
Therefore, in Jiang Chen's opinion, having more contact with the heroines in those movies and TV series might trigger other functions of the system.
"Then I wonder what brand of clothes Mr. Jiang wants to buy?" Chen Qianqian asked.
"I think when buying clothes, you should not look at the brand, but whether they are comfortable. Miss Chen, what do you think?" In Jiang Chen's previous life, he once liked those famous brands. Even before making money, I bought a lot of mid-range brand clothes.
But now he figured it out.
This behavior is that of the nouveau riche.
Therefore, although he is now considered a billionaire, he does not buy many high-end brands.
"That's what Mr. Jiang said."
What can Chen Qianqian say?
She suspected that Jiang Chen was pretending to be thirteen, but unfortunately there was no evidence.
"Come on, let's go in and take a look."
Jiang Chen and Chen Qianqian entered a big-name clothing store.
Because it was Jiang Chen who bought the clothes, after entering the store, all he saw were men's clothes.
The specialty store is still very large, and people are coming and going inside, which proves the popularity and quality here.
"Sir, how can I help you?" As soon as the sales lady saw Jiang Chen and Chen Qianqian, a team of handsome men and women, she knew that a big customer was coming, and she said with a warm and bright smile.
"These sets look good to me. Take them down and let me try them out." Jiang Chen had no intention of listening to the sales introduction.
Jiang Chen didn't care whether the clothes looked good or not, as long as they fit him, he would buy them.
"This one fits."
"This one's not bad either."
"Well, I want this one."
After trying on several clothes, Jiang Chen would nod and ask the sales lady to wrap them up if he liked them.
Not long after, the two came out. The difference from before entering was that Jiang Chen and Chen Qianqian had several more sets of clothes in their hands. Well, actually there wasn't much more. Apart from buying a few pieces for himself, Jiang Chen just went to a women's clothing store and bought a set of clothes for Chen Qianqian. The price was also very cheap, only a few thousand yuan. It was considered a gift for Chen Qianqian.
Chen Qianqian was very evasive.
If it weren't for Jiang Chen's persistence, I'm afraid he wouldn't have asked for anything.
"It's just a piece of clothing, why do you care? If you hadn't gone shopping with me, I might have been bored to death." Jiang Chen and Chen Qianqian said with a smile as they walked side by side.
Chen Qianqian felt embarrassed to accept a piece of clothing from Jiang Chen just after meeting him for the second time.
Two hours later, Jiang Chen and Chen Qianqian were both a little tired.
"Miss Chen, thank you for today. How about I treat you to dinner?" Jiang Chen said to Chen Qianqian.
"No, I still have something to do." Chen Qianqian shook her head.
Jiang Chen is too enthusiastic.
She felt that Jiang Chen might be interested in her, which made her at a loss. She even regretted calling Jiang Chen before, so she didn't want to stay with Jiang Chen at this time.
"Then I'll invite you again when I have time." Jiang Chen didn't force it.
Although he feels good being with Chen Qianqian, and he even has plans to develop further, after all, this is the second time the two have met, and if they continue to be entangled, it will only be self-defeating.
After saying goodbye to Chen Qianqian, Jiang Chen returned to his residence.
This time he spent more than 100,000 yuan, buying about ten sets of clothes and some shoes.
